transcript: Speaker A: Speak this clearly and fast. Speaker B: English speaking seekhna hai toh PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app right now.]
on_screen_text: Speak this clearly and fast. I want to learn English... But right now... I understand everything... but I cannot speak... Then I found PW Talk... I met RIVA — my AI speaking partner... Download PW Talk. Start at just ₹7. Want To Improve Your Spoken English? PW TALK APP.
summary: The ad targets learners who understand English but struggle to speak it. It highlights PW Talk's AI partner, Riva, for judgment-free daily practice. It ends with a call to action to download the app for just ₹7.
